name: better-autosuggestion
description: Fixes Antigravity IDE autocomplete ghost text positioning (CRLF offset drift, mid-line insertions, and native ghost text coalescing) using 100% built-in Antigravity AI.

commands.title: Better Autosuggestion: Apply Core Patch to Antigravity
Better Autosuggestion: Restore Original Antigravity Extension

betterAutosuggestion.enabled.description: Enable Better Autosuggestion runtime wrapper and ghost text position fixes.

betterAutosuggestion.fixCrlfDrift.description: Normalize CRLF (\r\n) and LF (\n) offsets between the editor document and Antigravity's characterDiff stream.

betterAutosuggestion.preferNativeGhostTe.description: Coalesce cursor-line edits into native VS Code InlineCompletionItem ghost text instead of custom green-highlighted inline edits.

betterAutosuggestion.allowMidLineMultili.description: Allow multiline completions when the cursor is before closing brackets/braces on the same line.

betterAutosuggestion.autoPatchCoreExtens.description: Automatically apply and maintain the core patch on Antigravity's built-in agy extension (survives IDE updates).

betterAutosuggestion.debugLogging.description: Log detailed before/after diff and ghost text position diagnostics to the Better Autosuggestion output channel.
